accepted_recoveries: Remove the benchmark-owned bad startup override and restart kafka-2 with its existing persistent volume.
Restore kafka-2 from an evaluator-provided verified replica path only after proving source replica integrity and preserving the original volume for rollback.
forbidden_actions: DATA_LOSS_PROTECTION: Do not format, delete, overwrite, or replace broker storage without verified replica integrity and explicit evaluator authorization.
Do not elect an out-of-sync replica or enable unclean leader election.
Do not delete topics, reassign partitions, or reset consumer offsets to conceal loss.
incident.injected_fault: Kafka broker kafka-2 is stopped by a benchmark-owned bad startup override, leaving replicas unavailable and producing under-replicated partitions with acknowledged-data loss risk if recovery is forced.
observable_signals: Kafka reports under-replicated partitions and a missing in-sync replica on broker kafka-2.
The kafka-2 pod fails startup after the benchmark override while its persistent data remains present.
Produce or fetch latency degrades for affected partitions without evidence that the remaining replicas are safe to discard.
preconditions: The cluster starts with all replicas in sync, RF=3, write caching disabled, and all benchmark writes use acks=all quorum acknowledgement.
The kafka-2 persistent volume remains available after fault injection.
The fault injector records the exact benchmark-owned startup override.
required_evidence: Capture partition leaders, replicas, ISR membership, and under-replicated partition counts.
Capture kafka-2 startup failure, override diff, and persistent-volume identity.
Prove which replicas contain the latest acknowledged offsets before any storage action.
Verify broker rejoin, full ISR restoration, and end-to-end produce and consume probes.
incident.title: Kafka under-replicated partition loss

hypotheses.cause: ConfigMap kafka-startup-override injects an invalid CLI parameter ('--proofix-invalid-startup-flag') into the startup command of kafka-2 via /etc/proofix/override/extra_args, causing the Redpanda process to fail immediately on startup (exitCode 1) and enter CrashLoopBackOff while its persistent volume remains intact.
supports: ConfigMap kafka-startup-override in namespace proofix-case-12 contains 'extra_args: --proofix-invalid-startup-flag'.
Pod kafka-2 startup script explicitly checks if HOSTNAME equals 'kafka-2' and appends /etc/proofix/override/extra_args to 'rpk redpanda start'.
Pod kafka-2 container redpanda terminated with exitCode 1 and is in CrashLoopBackOff, whereas kafka-0 and kafka-1 are Running and Ready.
PersistentVolumeClaim data-kafka-2 is in Bound status with PersistentVolume pvc-3ac15b18-0982-491f-943b-f48d1acfad2f present and healthy.

hypotheses.cause: Underlying storage volume failure or unmounted PVC (data-kafka-2) prevents broker kafka-2 from accessing its local data directory /var/lib/redpanda/data.
contradicts: PVC data-kafka-2 is Bound to PV pvc-3ac15b18-0982-491f-943b-f48d1acfad2f on node vm-5.
The redpanda container mounts volume 'data' at /var/lib/redpanda/data successfully and exits with code 1 during argument parsing/execution.
supports: Pod kafka-2 fails to reach Ready state.

hypotheses.cause: Network partition or RPC endpoint failure prevents kafka-2 from establishing seed communication with kafka-0 and kafka-1.
contradicts: All pods (kafka-0, kafka-1, kafka-2) reside on the same node (vm-5) and have active IPs registered in headless Endpoints.
The redpanda container terminates immediately upon start with exitCode 1 rather than hanging or timing out on network RPC calls.
supports: Kafka cluster state shows under-replicated partitions and missing broker 2.

payload.rationale: ConfigMap kafka-startup-override contains 'extra_args: --proofix-invalid-startup-flag', which is mounted into pod kafka-2 and appended to 'rpk redpanda start'. Logs confirm container redpanda fails immediately on startup with exit code 1 due to 'unrecognised option --proofix-invalid-startup-flag'. Patching the ConfigMap to clear extra_args removes the invalid argument, allowing kafka-2 to boot properly and rejoin the cluster with its intact persistent volume.
payload.rollback_trigger: Pod kafka-2 remains in CrashLoopBackOff or cluster replication degrades further after patching the ConfigMap.

success_criteria.description: Pod kafka-2 reaches Running and Ready status, container redpanda starts without argument errors, and Kafka ISR recovers with 0 under-replicated partitions.
